tools.name: list_lint_rules
tools.description: List every Voice Agent Linter rule with its id, title, default severity, category, what it reads (prompt, config or both) and the platforms it applies to. Filter by platform or category. Static reference, no network access.

tools.name: explain_lint_rule
tools.description: Explain one Voice Agent Linter rule by id: why it exists, a bad and a good example, the fix, the platforms it applies to, and its sources with the date each was read. Static reference, no network access.
